name: Airgain, Inc. Common Stock
description: Airgain Incs a provider of advance wireless connectivity solutions. It is focused on delivering high-performance, cost-effective, and energy-efficient wireless solutions that enable rapid market deployment. It mission is to connect the world through integrated, and optimized wireless solutions. Companies' diverse product portfolio serves three primary markets: enterprise, automotive, and consumer. While historically recognized for high-performance radio frequency (RF) components, Airgain is increasingly delivering integrated, system-level connectivity solutions that combine hardware, software, and cloud management. The enterprise market demands reliable wireless access across diverse settings, including smart cities, campuses, stadiums, transportation hubs, utilities, buildings suburbs.
